create_multilingual_mscoco_dataset: create a Multilingual_MSCOCO VisionDataset instance from an annotation JSON file with optional transforms
get_item_from_dataset: get an image and its multilingual caption from the dataset by index using __getitem__
create_annotation_file: create a multilingual MSCOCO annotation JSON file for a given language code by downloading images and captions
download_multilingual_images: download and extract multilingual MSCOCO images from the remote tar.gz archive to a local directory
get_lines_from_url: fetch text lines from a remote URL using an HTTP GET request with a 30-second timeout
